title: Classic Hakka Noodles - Pack of 4
body_html:
WickedGud Classic Hakka Noodles are made from whole wheat flour (atta), split moong beans (moong dal), oat flour, brown rice flour, jowar flour, and tapioca starch. No maida. Completely oil-free, no frying at all.

Each 200g serving provides 15g protein (from moong dal and wheat gluten) and 9g dietary fibre (from oats and whole wheat). Trans fat: 0g. Saturated fat: 0.17g per serving.

The noodle base is built for Indo-Chinese stir-fry cooking, tossed with vegetables, soy sauce, chilli oil, or your preferred sauce. Cooks in 6 to 8 minutes. Strain, add sauce, done.

title: Nourishing Instant Noodles Masala - Pack of 10
body_html:
Your favourite WickedGud Indian masala noodles, now made healthy with whole wheat flour. Packed with flavour, fibre, and nutrition, they make for a comforting, quick meal anytime hunger strikes. The noodle cake contains no maida. Bold Indian masala seasoning: chilli, coriander, cumin, turmeric, fennel, pepper, garlic, onion, and carrot.

title: Multigrain Spaghetti Pasta - Pack of 4
body_html:
WickedGud Multigrain Spaghetti Pasta is made from durum wheat semolina (70%), red lentils (12%), chickpeas (8.7%), split moong beans (moong dal), brown rice flour, and tapioca starch. No maida. No oil. No palm oil.

Per 100g: 13.4g protein, 7.4g dietary fibre, 353 kcal, 75g carbohydrates, 1.4g total fat. Zero sodium added beyond the starch and semolina.

Long thin strands built for tomato-based sauces (arrabbiata, bolognese, marinara), aglio e olio, and Alfredo. Cooks in 8 to 10 minutes. Contains durum wheat. Not gluten-free.
